messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] 3460001111 - compatibility-detect
- model: llama3q-quant-v2
- runtime: runtime-3.4.0
- sdk: vendored-sdk-2.8.1
- observed: sporadic kvcache integrity errors + handful of SIGSEGVs on eu-west canary
- recommended: region-scoped routing pin to runtime-3.3 OR rebuild eu images with SDK 2.8.0

alex_chan: Noted. Seen on a eu-west canary (0.3% traffic) and a staging node that shares kernel ABI. US clusters unaffected.

maria_g: Is a routing pin safe wrt Dedicated customers? We cant violate pinned runtime contracts.

alex_chan: Routing-only. Will only affect hosted shared pools for the llama3q-quant model group. Dedicated or reserved capacity remains at their configured runtime.

ken_lee: Quick hypothesis: runtime 3.4 changed page-alignment for kvcache, SDK 2.8.1 altered tensor header packing. When mapped, offsets misalign.

sophie: Short-term mitigation: soft-route llama3q-quant eu-west -> runtime-3.3. Low blast radius. Ops runbook command below.

opsbot: runbook snippet:
``
/deploybot pin --model-group=llama3q-quant --runtime=runtime-3.3 --region=eu-west --reason="kvcache+sdk-2.8.1 compat"
``
If pin fails: fallback route to replica-region us-west and page an oncall.

alex_chan: Submitting pin now. Ill verify telemetry and hold for a 20m observation window.

deploy-bot: [ACK] job 90021 queued -> applying

opsbot: job 90021 -> success. Routing change applied: ~0.3% traffic for llama3q-quant in eu-west now served by runtime-3.3.

maria_g: Monitoring: error-rate dropped to baseline within 7m. p99 latency stable. Good sign.

ken_lee: I'll open a PR to rebuild eu images with vendored-sdk=2.8.0 as a parallel remediation. Link when ready. Also adding a quant-path CI test to premerge.

sophie: Drafting a short status page entry and internal blurb for support. Will avoid technical detail in public note.

alex_chan: Action owners: Alex - routing & postmortem draft; Ken - SDK rollback PR + CI test; Sophie - status page & customer note; Maria - customer watch.

ken_lee: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/merge_requests/1333 - eu image: pin vendored-sdk -> 2.8.0. Requesting release-eng review.

opsbot: observation checkpoint 3460001900 -> metrics nominal. Will escalate to #incidents on threshold breach.

sophie: Customer-facing note (internal review): "We've temporarily routed quantized llama3 traffic in eu-west to a previous runtime due to a compatibility issue between runtime 3.4 and a recent SDK change. Impacted traffic was small; no customer data affected. We're rolling back the SDK in the eu image and monitoring."

maria_g: Please make sure Dedicated tenants with contractual runtime pins are excluded from routing rules.

alex_chan: Confirmed - deploybot pin excludes configured Dedicated pools.

opsbot: last_check 3460002200 - routing pin active, monitoring green. Close this thread once postmortem doc link is attached.

alex_chan: Postmortem draft will be posted to docs/reports and linked here when ready. Closing coordination thread after PM ack.
